profile.headline: Software Engineer at Blue Cross Blue Shield Arizona
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the medical health industry. Skilled in C#, SQL, Powerscript and HTML. Have been in the industry for the last 23 years.

positions.title: Services Engineer III Team Lead
positions.description:
• Managed and oversaw developers on two different products
• Trained and assigned work to programmers, designers and other engineering personnel
• Implemented and coordinated client development projects

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Produced data conversion programs to port data between different software products and databases
• Direct software programming and development of documentation 
• Consult with engineering staff to evaluate interface between hardware and software
• Develop specifications and performance requirements and resolve customer problems

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: I started my business as a Graphic Designer so I could work from home.  As a Graphic Designer, I designed and sold business cards, brochures, flyers, posters, designed web sites and developed PowerPoint presentations.  I worked with Adobe Photoshop, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint.
